summary: Allows the least-privilege database migration and preflight hooks to start when the shared production configuration module validates application-only settings.
userImpact: Managed Helm installations no longer fail before migration because JWT, administrator, and encryption settings are intentionally absent from the database hook Secrets.
configuration: The chart supplies fixed validation-only values to the short-lived database hooks; operators do not need to add application credentials to migration or preflight Secrets.

notes: The fix changes only hook startup configuration and does not alter migration contents or database schemas.

security: Migration and preflight identities retain least privilege and still cannot read the application Secret.
The injected values are fixed validation-only placeholders and are never used by API or worker workloads.
documentation: The Helm chart operator guide documents the database hook validation-only configuration profile.
rollback: Restore the previous chart templates; no data rollback is required.
validation: The complete enterpriseglue-host chart contract suite passes 57 tests and helm lint.
Rendered migration and preflight Jobs contain every required validation-only setting and no application Secret reference.
